name: dev-spec-driven
description: Unified, track-based spec-driven development: EARS requirements, technical design, traceable tasks, and approval-gated execution. Composes optional TDD, SaaS-scale, AI-eval, security and privacy (GDPR) tracks per feature. Ships a fully local, zero-dependency MCP server (tools, prompts and specs:// resources) for spec scaffolding, classification, EARS linting, traceability, evidence-gated task tracking, change impact, metrics, a living spec catalog, drift checks, project templates, stakeholder export, release notes, a decision log, roadmap forecasts, and import from Kiro / spec-kit / OpenSpec / plans / ExecPlans / BMAD. No cloud, no CI, no cost.

default_lang.title: Default language for new projects
default_lang.description: en, pt (European Portuguese), pt-BR or es — the language a NEW dev-spec project gets when spec_init / its first spec_create names none (seeded into .specs/roadmap.json meta.lang). Empty = en. A project that has a language keeps it.

stop_check.title: End-of-turn evidence gate
stop_check.description: Send a turn back when it claims done while recently ticked tasks lack verification evidence. Off here switches it off in every project that does not set it itself (roadmap.json meta.stopCheck wins).

guard_default.title: Guard mode default
guard_default.description: off, on or scope — the guard mode of a project whose roadmap.json leaves meta.guard unset (on: code edits ask while no feature has approved tasks; scope: also a code file no open task plans). A project setting (/spec-guard) wins.
